symbolDescription: Props for PdfToolbar: the viewer API it controls, its labels and configuration, the compact layout and the page indicator slot.

optionDescriptions.api: The viewer API, from a ref or renderToolbar.
optionDescriptions.compact: Compact layout: hides hiddenWhenCompact actions outside fullscreen.
optionDescriptions.menuPlacement: Where the More actions menu opens. PdfViewer picks the side away from the edge.
optionDescriptions.pageIndicator: Replaces the page indicator text, e.g. with your own input.
optionDescriptions.zoomReset: The zoom label becomes a reset button.
